mechanism: Both drugs are highly teratogenic and indomethacin increases isotretinoin toxicity through shared hepatic metabolism and additive GI/renal effects; NSAIDs impair renal function potentially elevating isotretinoin levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use alternative analgesia/anti-inflammatory agent, ensure robust contraception for isotretinoin, and monitor renal function and triglycerides closely.
